headline: NYM @ MIA matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is NYM 5.68 at MIA 4.20, with a projected total of 9.88. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward NYM: NYM moved +1.26 runs while MIA moved +0.66, changing the projected margin by +0.60 runs. The projected total climbed +1.93, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Tyler Phillips has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Juan Soto, Xavier Edwards, Otto Lopez, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags MJ Melendez, Esteury Ruiz because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
